title: XDS AD350 power-meter launch and construction report
notes: Attributable report of the 8 March 2025 AD350 launch identifies the exact CNY 3,998 complete bike, an X6 ultra-light aluminum aero frame, carbon-fiber fork and seatpost, and a 9.6 kg size-450 launch reference. The newer official-account 9.28 kg claim remains the retained weight fact.
